title: •Tigran Jamiro
caption: •Tigran Jamiro (V)
game_text: Deploys free to Dantooine, Hoth, or Yavin 4. At same and related sites, opponent’s aliens and Imperials are deploy +1.
lore: Senior logistics officer from Onderon. Left Dantooine to serve on Yavin 4 before coming to Hoth. All personnel entering Echo Base must report to him.
